purpose: Re-weight the v9 side against the fold side of v33's recipe on the fair development set (configs/fair_dev_v1.json), where every recipe month compares both sides on equal footing. Declared before any fair-set row or score exists (runs/fair_dev/rows.parquet absent at declaration).

prior_context.shipped_set_readings: on the shipped (v9-favouring) development set: unmatched non-LTFM outer weight 0.8 gave Dec -0.10% but Jan/Jul worse; LIRF v9 shares lower gave Dec -0.03..-0.07% (intervals across zero), Nov worse; these motivated the candidates and are disclosed
prior_context.v33: outer weight LTFM 1.0 / other matched non-LIRF 0.6 / other unmatched 0.7 officially 228.7246 (-0.374% vs v31), matching the equal-footing December reading

rows: runs/fair_dev/rows.parquet from tools/run_fair_dev.py (fair provenance columns: v9, base, mix, lirf_tree, lirf_net, v30, v33, floor, scope flags)

control.name: v33
control.reproduction: the round's rebuild of the control must equal the fair v33 column of rows.parquet to 1e-9 s per row

candidate_semantics: Each candidate overrides only the named control weights. Outer: value = max((1 - w) * base + w * mix, floor) on non-LIRF rows, w by scope (LTFM rows; other ADS-B-matched non-LIRF rows; other unmatched non-LIRF rows). LIRF: on lirf_nonpop_matched / lirf_nonpop_unmatched rows value = max(s * v9 + (1 - s) * (net_w * lirf_net + tree_w * lirf_tree) / (net_w + tree_w), floor) with the control's net/tree proportions and the candidate's v9 share s; every other LIRF row (fill population, fixed rows) keeps the control.
selection: Unchanged rule: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0), the mean ratio over the four months is at least 0.02% below 1, and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference lies below zero. Choose the lowest mean ratio among eligible candidates (ties by name); otherwise keep v33. If two or more candidates touching disjoint scopes are eligible, a combination is declared and scored before any export.
ship: If selected: rebuild on the final-file runner's dry-run detail with the selected weights, delta against the v33 weights added to v33's floats (tools/export_v33.py construction), floor -12, export as the next version, independent rebuild, audit. Upload only on the user's decision.
